subtopic: Types of Reactions — Combination, Decomposition, Displacement
stem:
Which characteristic is observed by the reaction shown in the given image?

The figure shows a conical flask containing zinc granules and dilute sulphuric acid, closed with a cork carrying a glass tube, through which Gas A is being given off: \(\text{Zn} + \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 \rightarrow \text{ZnSO}_4 + \text{H}_2\uparrow\)

options.label: D
options.text: Both change in temperature and evolution of gas

stem:
Which type of chemical reaction is shown in the given image?

The figure shows two neutral atoms A and B (each marked with charge 0). An electron (e\(^-\)) is transferred from A to B, producing a positive ion A\(^+\) and a negative ion B\(^-\).
